sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS net_fee_revenue FROM (SELECT o.order_id,substr(o.order_ts,1,10) AS entry_date,o.event_id,CASE WHEN t.ticket_type='resale' THEN 'resale_buyer' ELSE 'service' END AS fee_type,t.service_fee AS amount FROM tickets t JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=t.order_id JOIN events e ON e.event_id=o.event_id WHERE e.venue_id<>'V99' AND t.service_fee>0 UNION ALL SELECT o.order_id,substr(o.order_ts,1,10),o.event_id,'demand',t.demand_fee FROM tickets t JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=t.order_id JOIN events e ON e.event_id=o.event_id WHERE e.venue_id<>'V99' AND t.demand_fee>0 UNION ALL SELECT o.order_id,substr(o.order_ts,1,10),o.event_id,'resale_seller',t.seller_fee FROM tickets t JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=t.order_id JOIN events e ON e.event_id=o.event_id WHERE e.venue_id<>'V99' AND t.seller_fee>0 UNION ALL SELECT o.order_id,substr(o.order_ts,1,10),o.event_id,'order_processing',o.order_processing_fee FROM orders o JOIN events e ON e.event_id=o.event_id WHERE e.venue_id<>'V99' AND o.order_processing_fee>0 UNION ALL SELECT o.order_id,substr(o.order_ts,1,10),o.event_id,'delivery',o.delivery_fee FROM orders o JOIN events e ON e.event_id=o.event_id WHERE e.venue_id<>'V99' AND o.delivery_fee>0 UNION ALL SELECT r.order_id,substr(r.refund_ts,1,10),o.event_id,'refunded',-(r.service_fee_refunded+r.demand_fee_refunded+r.order_fees_refunded) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id JOIN events e ON e.event_id=o.event_id WHERE e.venue_id<>'V99' AND r.service_fee_refunded+r.demand_fee_refunded+r.order_fees_refunded>0 UNION ALL SELECT o.order_id,substr(o.order_ts,1,10),o.event_id,'facility',t.facility_fee FROM tickets t JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=t.order_id JOIN events e ON e.event_id=o.event_id WHERE e.venue_id<>'V99' AND t.ticket_type='primary' AND t.facility_fee>0) WHERE substr(entry_date,1,4)='2026'
